info.title: TikTok Keyword Suggestions API: Search Autocomplete Terms
info.description:
TikTok search autocomplete suggestions for your seed keywords as JSON.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/tiktok-keyword-suggestions (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Collect ranked TikTok autocomplete suggestions from seed keywords with bounded alphabet, number and recursive expansion plus transparent frequency signals. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: Seed terms to send to TikTok autocomplete.

expandAlphabet.title: A-Z expansion
expandAlphabet.description: Append a through z to each seed before querying.

expandNumbers.title: 0-9 expansion
expandNumbers.description: Append zero through nine to each seed before querying.

expansionDepth.title: Recursive expansion depth
expansionDepth.description: Feed returned suggestions back into autocomplete. Zero uses only the initial query set; one is usually enough for broader research.

language.title: Request language
language.description: Accept-Language value used for the public TikTok request. Results can still reflect TikTok's own localization logic.

maxQueries.title: Maximum query requests
maxQueries.description: Hard request budget across seeds and all expansions. A request returns 20 rows at most.

maxSuggestionsPerQuery.title: Maximum suggestions per query
maxSuggestionsPerQuery.description: Maximum TikTok suggestions retained from each request.

maxResults.title: Maximum total results
maxResults.description: Maximum suggestion rows saved to the dataset.

deduplicateSuggestions.title: Deduplicate suggestions
deduplicateSuggestions.description: Merge the same suggestion across queries and report how often it appeared as volume_proxy.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
